description: Address review feedback (iteration 1): Fix pass 2 separate_av_latent output index, fix fallback path audio concat, and load CLIP for LTXDirector.
steps: STEP 1 - Fix pass 2 separate_av_latent to use output_index=0 instead of output_index=1 (the workflow JSON wires slot 0 from SamplerCustomAdvanced to LTXVSeparateAVLatent for both passes).
STEP 2 - Fix fallback path in generate_chunk: when dir_video_latent is None but dir_audio_latent is valid, set audio_latent_for_concat = dir_audio_latent instead of None.
STEP 3 - Load CLIP via DualCLIPLoader in build_director_conditioning and pass it to director_kwargs, following the same pattern as build_text_conditioning.
acceptance_criteria: Python file passes py_compile and ast.parse without errors
Fallback path sets audio_latent_for_concat = dir_audio_latent when dir_video_latent is None
DualCLIPLoader is called in build_director_conditioning and result passed to director_kwargs as clip
findings: All 3 review issues fixed: (1) Pass 2 separate_av_latent corrected to output_index=0 matching the workflow JSON that wires SamplerCustomAdvanced slot 0 to LTXVSeparateAVLatent; (2) Fallback path now uses dir_audio_latent (valid from _build_director_fallback) instead of None, so AV-concat still works even without LTXDirector video latent; (3) CLIP is now loaded via DualCLIPLoader with the same pattern as build_text_conditioning and passed to LTXDirector via director_kwargs['clip'].
